name: publish_work
description: Publish this workstream's worktree changes: commit them, push the branch, and optionally open a pull request. Use after dispatch_agent has produced a diff you are satisfied with — this is how work leaves the worktree and becomes reviewable. Never pushes to the default branch; it pushes the workstream's own branch and opens a PR against the default. Actions: 'status' (what is pending, which credential would be used — read-only), 'push' (commit and push the branch), 'pr' (commit, push, and open a pull request).

action.description: What to do. 'status' is read-only and safe to call first.

message.description: Commit message. Required for 'push' and 'pr' when there are uncommitted changes. Write it as a real commit message: what changed and why.

title.description: Pull request title. Defaults to the commit message's first line.

body.description: Pull request body. Say what was changed, how it was verified, and anything you are unsure about.

base.description: Branch to open the pull request against. Defaults to the repository's default branch.
